stem: Orchid Search preloads a large in-memory index each morning and startup takes 14 minutes, but daytime traffic is elastic.

choices.text: Hibernate pre-warmed instances and use Auto Scaling for daytime demand.
Stop instances nightly and rebuild the index every morning
Replace scaling policy with vertical-only resizing
Use Reserved Instances while keeping current scaling behavior.

rationale: Hibernation preserves RAM state for faster resume of pre-warmed instances, and Auto Scaling handles daytime elasticity. Stopping instances clears RAM and forces full reload. Vertical-only resizing does not address startup-time recovery pattern. Reserved pricing can reduce cost rate but does not solve the warm-start behavior requirement.
